name: @burtson-labs/demo-videos-truemarks
description: Self-contained Playwright demo-video pipeline for the TrueMarks products (VidRec LE, VidEx LE). Records PUBLIC truemarks.ai marketing pages only — no logins. Finished videos land in ~/Desktop/bandit-demos; nothing is published or committed.

scripts.vidrec: npm run record:vidrec && npm run assemble:vidrec
scripts.videx: npm run record:videx && npm run assemble:videx
scripts.all: npm run vidrec && npm run videx
